findings.text: If options.shell is a boolean (false or true), normalizeFileUrl(false) will likely crash since it expects a path or URL string. Failing input: {shell: false}.

If file is a file URL (e.g., 'file:///C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe'), basename returns the URL string minus '.exe' which won't equal 'cmd', so the /q flag is not added on Windows. Failing input: first argument 'file:///C:/Windows/System32/cmd.exe'.

0.reason: The code calls normalizeFileUrl(options.shell) which is a separate function not shown in the patch, and the claim that it crashes on boolean shell values cannot be confirmed from the provided code.

1.reason: The code uses basename(file, '.exe') which correctly strips the .exe extension from a file URL path, so the /q flag would be added for file URLs pointing to cmd.exe.
